name: Haruka-sama
source: The former ruler of Arcadare Empire, who was loved and respected by everyone, because she made Arcadare civilisation prosperous. She sacrificed her life to save Elena, and after that she became one of the spirits of the former rulers of Arcadare living in the Sacred Orb. Haruka was born on Earth.
